feat_descriptions.feat.acrobatic: Improves balance, tumbling, and jumping through nimble movement.
feat_descriptions.feat.agile: Improves balance and escape artistry with quick, controlled motion.
feat_descriptions.feat.alertness: Sharpens awareness of nearby sounds and visual details.
feat_descriptions.feat.animal-affinity: Improves handling and riding of animals.
feat_descriptions.feat.armor-proficiency-heavy: Lets you use heavy armor without the usual nonproficiency penalty.
feat_descriptions.feat.armor-proficiency-light: Lets you use light armor without the usual nonproficiency penalty.
feat_descriptions.feat.armor-proficiency-medium: Lets you use medium armor without the usual nonproficiency penalty.
feat_descriptions.feat.athletic: Improves climbing and swimming through physical conditioning.
feat_descriptions.feat.augment-summoning: Makes creatures you summon stronger and more resilient.
feat_descriptions.feat.blind-fight: Improves your ability to fight opponents you cannot see clearly.
feat_descriptions.feat.brew-potion: Allows you to create magical potions from spells you know.
feat_descriptions.feat.cleave: Grants a follow-up melee attack after you drop an opponent.
feat_descriptions.feat.combat-casting: Improves spellcasting concentration when danger threatens or distracts you.
feat_descriptions.feat.combat-expertise: Lets you trade accuracy in melee for stronger defense.
feat_descriptions.feat.combat-reflexes: Allows more attacks of opportunity and faster reactions to openings.
feat_descriptions.feat.craft-magic-arms-and-armor: Allows you to create magical weapons and armor.
feat_descriptions.feat.craft-rod: Allows you to create magical rods.
feat_descriptions.feat.craft-staff: Allows you to create magical staves.
feat_descriptions.feat.craft-wand: Allows you to create magical wands.
feat_descriptions.feat.craft-wondrous-item: Allows you to create a wide range of magical items.
feat_descriptions.feat.deceitful: Improves bluffing and disguising your intentions or identity.
feat_descriptions.feat.deflect-arrows: Lets you deflect a ranged weapon attack with a free hand.
feat_descriptions.feat.deft-hands: Improves delicate work such as disabling devices and opening locks.
feat_descriptions.feat.diehard: Lets you remain conscious and act while gravely wounded.
feat_descriptions.feat.diligent: Improves appraisal and deciphering written clues.
feat_descriptions.feat.dodge: Improves your defense against a chosen opponent.
feat_descriptions.feat.empower-spell: Increases the variable numeric effects of a spell.
feat_descriptions.feat.endurance: Improves your ability to withstand physical hardship and exhaustion.
feat_descriptions.feat.enlarge-spell: Increases the range of a spell.
feat_descriptions.feat.eschew-materials: Lets you cast spells without most minor material components.
feat_descriptions.feat.exotic-weapon-proficiency: Lets you wield one chosen exotic weapon without a proficiency penalty.
feat_descriptions.feat.extend-spell: Makes a spell with a duration last longer.
feat_descriptions.feat.extra-turning: Grants additional daily uses of your ability to turn or rebuke creatures.
feat_descriptions.feat.far-shot: Extends the effective range of ranged weapons.
feat_descriptions.feat.forge-ring: Allows you to create magical rings.
feat_descriptions.feat.great-cleave: Extends Cleave attacks when you defeat multiple opponents in succession.
feat_descriptions.feat.great-fortitude: Strengthens resistance to effects that test physical endurance.
feat_descriptions.feat.greater-spell-focus: Further improves the difficulty of resisting spells from a chosen school.
feat_descriptions.feat.greater-spell-penetration: Further improves attempts to overcome spell resistance.
feat_descriptions.feat.greater-two-weapon-fighting: Grants an additional off-hand attack when fighting with two weapons.
feat_descriptions.feat.greater-weapon-focus: Further improves attacks with a chosen weapon.
feat_descriptions.feat.greater-weapon-specialization: Further increases damage dealt with a chosen weapon.
feat_descriptions.feat.heighten-spell: Raises a spell's effective level and makes it harder to resist.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-bull-rush: Improves attempts to push an opponent back in combat.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-counterspell: Lets you counter spells using a spell from the same school.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-critical: Makes a chosen weapon more likely to land a critical hit.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-disarm: Improves attempts to knock an opponent's weapon away.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-familiar: Allows you to gain a more capable or unusual familiar.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-feint: Lets you mislead an opponent more quickly in combat.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-grapple: Improves grappling and reduces the risk of opening yourself to attack.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-initiative: Helps you act sooner when combat begins.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-overrun: Improves attempts to move through an opponent's space.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-precise-shot: Helps ranged attacks pass through concealment and cover.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-shield-bash: Lets you bash with a shield while retaining its defensive benefit.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-sunder: Improves attempts to damage an opponent's weapon or gear.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-trip: Improves attempts to knock opponents prone and follow up quickly.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-turning: Strengthens your ability to turn or rebuke creatures.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-two-weapon-fighting: Grants another off-hand attack when fighting with two weapons.
feat_descriptions.feat.improved-unarmed-strike: Makes your unarmed attacks more effective in a fight.
feat_descriptions.feat.investigator: Improves gathering information and searching for clues.
feat_descriptions.feat.iron-will: Strengthens resistance to effects that test resolve.
feat_descriptions.feat.leadership: Lets you attract a capable companion and a following.
feat_descriptions.feat.lightning-reflexes: Improves reactions to dangers that call for quick reflexes.
feat_descriptions.feat.magical-aptitude: Improves spellcraft and the use of magical devices.
feat_descriptions.feat.manyshot: Lets you loose multiple arrows as part of one ranged attack.
feat_descriptions.feat.martial-weapon-proficiency: Lets you use one chosen martial weapon without a proficiency penalty.
feat_descriptions.feat.maximize-spell: Raises a spell's variable numeric effects to their maximum.
feat_descriptions.feat.mobility: Improves your defense while moving past opponents in combat.
feat_descriptions.feat.mounted-archery: Improves ranged attacks made while riding a mount.
feat_descriptions.feat.mounted-combat: Helps protect your mount from attacks during combat.
feat_descriptions.feat.natural-spell: Lets you cast spells while using your druidic wild shape.
feat_descriptions.feat.negotiator: Improves diplomacy and reading another person's motives.
feat_descriptions.feat.nimble-fingers: Improves delicate work such as disabling devices and opening locks.
feat_descriptions.feat.point-blank-shot: Improves ranged attacks made at close distance.
feat_descriptions.feat.power-attack: Lets you trade melee accuracy for increased damage.
feat_descriptions.feat.precise-shot: Reduces the difficulty of ranged attacks into a melee.
feat_descriptions.feat.quick-draw: Lets you ready a weapon quickly as part of your action.
feat_descriptions.feat.quicken-spell: Lets you cast a spell with greatly reduced casting time.
feat_descriptions.feat.rapid-reload: Speeds up reloading of one chosen type of crossbow.
feat_descriptions.feat.rapid-shot: Grants an extra ranged attack during a full attack.
feat_descriptions.feat.ride-by-attack: Lets you strike during a mounted charge and keep moving.
feat_descriptions.feat.run: Improves your speed and distance when running.
feat_descriptions.feat.scribe-scroll: Allows you to create magical scrolls from spells you know.
feat_descriptions.feat.self-sufficient: Improves healing and survival in the wild.
feat_descriptions.feat.shield-proficiency: Lets you use shields without the usual nonproficiency penalty.
feat_descriptions.feat.shot-on-the-run: Lets you move before and after making a ranged attack.
feat_descriptions.feat.silent-spell: Lets you cast a spell without speaking its verbal component.
feat_descriptions.feat.simple-weapon-proficiency: Lets you use simple weapons without a proficiency penalty.
feat_descriptions.feat.skill-focus: Improves your ability with one chosen skill.
feat_descriptions.feat.snatch-arrows: Lets you catch a deflected ranged weapon and sometimes throw it back.
feat_descriptions.feat.spell-focus: Makes spells from one chosen school harder to resist.
feat_descriptions.feat.spell-mastery: Lets a wizard prepare selected spells without consulting a spellbook.
feat_descriptions.feat.spell-penetration: Improves attempts to overcome a creature's spell resistance.
feat_descriptions.feat.spirited-charge: Increases the impact of a mounted charge.
feat_descriptions.feat.spring-attack: Lets you move, strike an opponent, and continue moving.
feat_descriptions.feat.stealthy: Improves hiding and moving without being heard.
feat_descriptions.feat.still-spell: Lets you cast a spell without making gestures.
feat_descriptions.feat.stunning-fist: Can leave a struck opponent stunned by an unarmed attack.
feat_descriptions.feat.toughness: Increases your ability to withstand injury.
feat_descriptions.feat.tower-shield-proficiency: Lets you use tower shields without a proficiency penalty.
feat_descriptions.feat.track: Lets you follow trails and identify tracks.
feat_descriptions.feat.trample: Lets your mount overrun opponents more effectively.
feat_descriptions.feat.two-weapon-defense: Improves defense while wielding a weapon in each hand.
feat_descriptions.feat.two-weapon-fighting: Reduces penalties when attacking with a weapon in each hand.
feat_descriptions.feat.weapon-finesse: Lets you use agility rather than strength with certain light weapons.
feat_descriptions.feat.weapon-focus: Improves attacks with one chosen weapon.
feat_descriptions.feat.weapon-specialization: Increases damage dealt with one chosen weapon.
feat_descriptions.feat.whirlwind-attack: Lets you attack nearby opponents during one sweeping action.
feat_descriptions.feat.widen-spell: Increases the area affected by a spell.
